children: Options traders are preparing for turbulence in Nvidia shares after the company reports earnings later today.
The options market is pricing in a 7.9% move in Nvidia shares, higher or lower, in the session after the chip maker reports earnings, according to Option Research & Technology Services data.
Nvidia shares have swung 5.6% on average following the company's past 12 earnings reports, ORATS added.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
